theme: PDF encryption with fixture password (open+owner, ALLOW_PRINT)
title: Encrypted PDF — minimal ACTIVE sample
description: Minimal encrypted-PDF sample. DOCX half asserts the assembled document carries the sample body. PDF half synthesizes a PDF from the assembled DOCX text (no soffice required), encrypts it with a test-fixture open/owner password, asserts the PDF cannot be opened without the password, then asserts the body is extractable after decryption. Fixture password is test-only and never logged.
